name: 922 Setup
description: Runs the full 922 batch-prep sequence behind a master toggle window: Batch Folder Setup (order folders from the REV C PO sheet, per-order PO workbook copy, work-packet PDFs filed in), Generate Teams Cards (pipeline buckets + one pallet-labelled Teams card per order via a Power Automate webhook), Batch Repeater (pull repeats, distribute CAD/binders, label REPEAT cards), and Pallet Stamper - each stage toggleable, batch number shared across stages.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Sync the '922 QTDR Production Packages' folder. The batch's folder (e.g. Batch 487) needs its Documentation folder with the 'PO H{n} QF-QU-09 REV C' workbook.
Drop the batch's work-packet PDFs into a 'Work Packets' folder inside the batch folder, each PDF's name containing its order number.
For pallet labels and stamping, the Pallet & Rod Organizer must be in the Documentation folder.
how_it_works: Pick the batch folder, then choose which stages to run in the toggle window (they run top to bottom).
Batch Folder Setup builds an order folder per order and files the work-packet PDFs in; Generate Teams Cards posts the D922 pipeline buckets and one card per order.

Pallet Stamper stamps each order's work packet with its batch and pallet, then Batch Repeater pulls repeats from prior batches. Stamping runs before the repeater on purpose, so repeats never get stamped.
output: Order folders built and filled, Teams cards posted to the D922 PIPELINE plan, work packets stamped, and repeat orders pulled into a REPEAT BATCHES folder.
Each stage you run earns tickets (all four = 20).

fields.label: 922 Production Packages Root
fields.description: Where 'Batch {N}' folders live. Leave blank to auto-detect '922 QTDR Production Packages' under your OneDrive Pilot Program folder.
fields.placeholder: Auto-detect: OneDrive \ ... \ Pilot Program \ 922 QTDR Production Packages

fields.label: Teams Webhook URL (override)
fields.description: Leave blank to use TechDeck's built-in card-creation flow. Only set this to point at a different Power Automate flow (get the URL from that flow's trigger). Use the Dry run toggle below to preview without posting.

fields.label: Dry run (preview only)
fields.description: When on, build and log the cards and save a preview JSON, but do not post to the webhook. Forced on automatically when no webhook URL is set.

fields.label: Sentry Drone mode
fields.description: Pick the file or folder through the targeting-drone kill-cam - crosshair cursor, lock-on, and a railgun strike on the target. Off = a normal Explorer dialog. Buy the Sentry Drone at Woogy's Emporium; set every app at once from My Stuff.
